text:
carmen: noticed spike in mTLS handshake fails after RBAC change at 05:02 UTC
liam: seeing same in eu-west proxy logs :eyes:
ashley: rolling back rbac change now, which one was it?
liam: changed `role:mtls-delegator` to remove kms:Decrypt for service-proxy group
marco: that was the helm patch I applied, thinking to tighten key access
ops-oncall: logs show TLS alert 42, backend KMS decrypt denied: `access denied for key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01`
security-bot: alert: 42 failed handshakes across proxies in eu-west and ap-south
carmen: steps: 1) revert role to previous (grant kms:Decrypt) 2) re-run canary 3) sample audit logs
liam: reverting now -> `kubectl -n infra patch role mtls-delegator --patch '{"rules":[{"apiGroups":[""],"resources":["secrets"],"verbs":["get"]}]}'`
marco: hold - we need an interim policy that allows Decrypt only for signed CSR flow: Condition: StringEquals kms:ViaService => tighter than full Decrypt
ashley: agree on narrower policy, but need quick restore to stop customer impact
ops-oncall: revert applied 05:07 UTC, proxies recovered in ~90s, handshake failures drop to 0
carmen: good. follow-ups: audit sampling config currently drops 95% of mTLS events, increase to 20% for next 6 hours
liam: where is sampling configured? observability -> audit -> samplingRules (console path)
marco: I can push a temp rule: sample where event.type==`mtls_handshake` && region==`eu-west`
security-bot: note: KMS deny reason recorded in audit: IAMPrincipalNotAuthorized with request context
ashley: capture proof for postmortem: save proxy logs, k8s events, IAM policy diff and `aws cloudtrail` entries
carmen: creating incident ticket and assigning postmortem owners: @liam @marco @ashley
ops-oncall: also thinking to add canary that exercises ACME signer and KMS decrypt path in staging to catch this
liam: action items: (1) produce RBAC change checklist with KMS integration signoff (2) add audit sampling override tool (3) smaller permissive role for canary
marco: I'll draft RBAC checklist and a temporary managed role template
ashley: I'll update incident notes and schedule a 1hr follow-up tomorrow 09:00 UTC
carmen: thanks team :thumbsup: closing thread once docs linked
security-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0453
